hypothesis: Full-cold exact-XOR recognition plus standalone GF2 elimination with complete original-CNF SAT witness replay can beat even the fastest competing general-purpose/native-XOR baseline on some preregistered XOR-rich Lights-out SAT instances; never infer gain on arbitrary SAT CNF.
measurement: full cold process end-to-end wall includes Python startup, generating/loading + SHA exact original, exact XOR recognition, setup, solve, independent full original CNF SAT model replay, full output

scientific_win_gate.per_case_per_host: All 3 same-source repetitions of JANUS GF2 and ALL 3 native-XOR CryptoMiniSat verified SAT, median full-cold speedup candidate over MINIMUM median of every successful baseline (CMS native, CMS original, CaDiCaL) >= 1.20. Any censored candidate/baseline => INDETERMINATE, not win.
scientific_win_gate.aggregated: At least 2 of 3 new sources meet strict per_case_per_host condition on BOTH hosts, no regression > 5 percent in the remaining SAT case on either host. All three source SHA unique and reported. No post hoc threshold or instance replacement.
scientific_win_gate.no_generalization: Even passing this gate means reproducible within Lights-out family, not general SAT and not independent external blind proof.

control_safety.unsat: Exact GF2 contradiction replay only; other solver UNSAT without portable proof is not positive timing evidence.
control_safety.reject_partial_XOR: Source XOR block recognition MUST exact-cover every original clause, otherwise abstain, no GF2 SAT claim
control_safety.validation_split: These deterministic new seeds are publicly preregistered (not externally hidden); separate independent blind future cohort needed before stage5 promotion.
control_safety.no_cost: Only existing public GitHub standard hosted runners; avoid paid Rowan/NAS/PC
control_safety.no_change_to: E12C4 state loop; C023 production; Meta Registry auto-promotion
